news.urls module

news/urls.py — URL patterns for the news application.

news.views module

news/views.py — Web UI views for the news application.

Fixes applied

  • Publisher registration: publishers can now register via /publishers/register/

  • Unique email: CustomUserCreationForm validates email uniqueness

  • Newsletter guardrail: readers only see approved articles in newsletters

  • Subscribe/unsubscribe: readers can follow publishers and journalists

news.views.article_approve(request, pk)[source]

Editors only: approve an article and notify subscribers.

On approval (Option 2 — without signals): 1. Marks article as approved with timestamp and approving editor. 2. Emails all subscribers of the journalist or publisher. 3. POSTs to /api/approved/ to log the approval.

Journalists only: submit a new article.

Editors or owning journalist: delete an article.

View a single approved article.

news.views.newsletter_create(request)[source]

Journalists and editors only: create a newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, pk)[source]

View a single newsletter.

Fix: readers only see approved articles within the newsletter. This prevents readers from accessing unapproved articles via newsletters. Editors and journalists see all articles.

news.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]

List all newsletters.

news.views.pending_articles(request)[source]

Editors only: list articles awaiting approval.

news.views.publisher_list(request)[source]

List all publishers with subscribe/unsubscribe buttons for readers.

news.views.register(request)[source]

Register a new user (reader, journalist, or editor).

Journalists and editors can select a publisher during registration. Email uniqueness is enforced by the form’s clean_email() method.

news.views.register_publisher(request)[source]

Register a new publisher (publication).

Publishers register separately. Once registered, journalists and editors can select the publisher when creating their accounts.

GET /publishers/register/ — show registration form POST /publishers/register/ — validate and save publisher
